variants.headline: Looking back: builder left unpaid for work done
variants.sub: The builder {builder} is owed payment by the client {client} for completed work.
variants.body:
We return to our earlier coverage. Our report recorded this: The client {client} had not paid {builder} for building work done.

Our principles require obligations to be considered on both sides of an undertaking. A client cannot be the only person whose expectations matter. The work and the payment belong in the same account of responsibility, rather than an argument that admires delivery while treating the money owed as an incidental inconvenience.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

We support {target} against a blanket adverse verdict. The missed payment requires attention, but its existence does not prove every allegation about motives or establish that the project has already reached a stop.
